text: Darngal ngal ɓadorii sabu yaltugol maɓɓe, kulol maggal e caɗeele maggal ɗen feeñi, e jaka yoo gite yedduɓe ɓen no udditii sabu saɗtude kulol maggal, ɓe wi'i: "Ee halkeede amen, gomɗii men laatinoke ka aduna e fijindaaru e welsindaare gaayi heblanagol ndee Ñalaande Mawnde, ko woni men laatinoke tooñirɓe keefeeru e waɗɗitagol geddi ɗin.
